theses.title: Indian Wind Energy Turnaround & C&I Captive Power Boom
theses.hypothesis: With zero promoter debt, 3.8 GW order backlog, and Ministry of Power 40% RTC mandates, domestic wind turbine manufacturers will see multi-year earnings compounding.

supporting_evidence.title: Ministry of Power Gazette Notification 44/2026
supporting_evidence.excerpt: 40% RTC renewable sourcing mandated for industrial users with 100% ISTS surcharge exemption.

risks: State regulatory commissions delaying enforcement deadlines
Grid evacuation bottlenecks in high-wind corridors of Gujarat and Tamil Nadu
invalidation_triggers: Suzlon quarterly order intake drops below 400 MW for 2 consecutive quarters
Operating cash flow to PAT conversion drops below 0.8x
